requirements: never initialize random weights as a substitute for a checkpoint
return generated text and execution metadata

acceptance_tests: verify output type and nonempty result
verify deterministic output under supported deterministic settings
test invalid paths and invalid parameters
status_detail: The inference runtime, artifact export and loading, tokenizer compatibility checks, SHA-256 integrity verification, and bounded text generation are implemented and covered by runtime tests. Loading and validating a verified trained checkpoint, followed by the complete end-to-end acceptance suite, remain outstanding acceptance gates.
